name: list-events
description: Lists the Outlook calendar's events and meetings in a time window, this week by default (now to seven days on); recurring meetings are expanded into occurrences. Calendar ids come from microsoft-outlook__list-calendars. Event ids feed microsoft-outlook__update-event, microsoft-outlook__delete-event and microsoft-outlook__respond-to-event.

start.description: Start of the time window in ISO 8601 format. Defaults to the current time.

end.description: End of the time window in ISO 8601 format. Defaults to seven days after start.

calendarId.description: Optional calendar ID from microsoft-outlook__list-calendars. When omitted, uses the default calendar.

top.description: Maximum number of events to return.

timeZone.description: IANA or Windows time zone name for returned event times.
